# Carry Exchange
> Carry is an AI powered, high-performance commodity exchange for trading commodity perpetual futures, tokenized commodities, prediction markets as well as options on commodities.

## Core Products
- [Perpetual Futures](https://carry.exchange): Speculate on commodity price movements with leverage and no expiration date.
- [Tokenized Spot Commodities](https://carry.exchange): Fractional ownership of physical commodities (Gold, Silver, Oil, Agri commodities, etc.) backed 1:1 by real-world assets (RWAs).
- [Prediction Markets](https://carry.exchange): Participate in event-based trading and commodity price forecasting.
- [Call & Put Options](https://carry.exchange): Buy and sell options on commodities to manage risk and speculate on price movements.

## Key Technical Features
- **AI-Native Infrastructure**: AI powered market making, Intelligent Order Routing, Predictive Matching, and AI-driven risk management tools. 
- **Institutional Security**: Bank-grade encryption, cold storage custody for tokenized assets, and built-in regulatory compliance.
- **Global Market Access**: 24/7 trading across 50+ global commodity markets with sub-milli-second execution.
- **Liquidity & Execution**: Smart order routing and high-throughput engine designed for institutional and retail traders.

## Supported Asset Classes
- **Precious Metals**: Gold (XAU), Silver (XAG), Platinum (XPT), Palladium (XPD).
- **Base Metals**: Gold (XAU), Silver (XAG), Platinum (XPT), Palladium (XPD).
- **Rare Earth Metals**: Gold (XAU), Silver (XAG), Platinum (XPT), Palladium (XPD).
- **Energy**: Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Electricity, 
- **Agriculture**: Wheat, Coffee, and other soft commodities.

## Status and Roadmap
- **Current Phase**: Pre-launch / Global Waitlist (11,000+ traders).
- **Official Launch**: Scheduled for Q2 2026.
- **Access**: Users can join the waitlist at [carry.exchange](https://carry.exchange) for early access and VIP benefits.
